fusions.name: Gallop Through
fusions.desc: Carries you up to 8 tiles to a target; the cut deals 16 damage and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Swath at a Canter
fusions.desc: Sweeps a fan 4 tiles ahead that deals 4 damage to everything in it. For 3 seconds after you use it, you move 10% faster.

fusions.name: Give It Its Head
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 35% for 8 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood, with +8% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Rolling Cadence
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (23% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
